test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: The ratio of two numbers is 3:7 and their sum is 200. Find the numbers.
solution:
Given : The ratio of two numbers is 3:7 and their sum is 200

Let the numbers be

 
• 3x and 7x
 
• 3 x + 7 x = 200
 
• 10 x = 200
 
• X = 20

 

Find the numbers

 
• 3x = 3 × 20 = 60
 
• 7x = 7 × 20 = 140

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
